name: Sepse
body:
Sepse
CR 1/2

This brownish snake gives off an acrid odor. Vapor rises from the ground where its fangs drip globules of acid on the sand.

XP 200
N Tiny animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 15, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex +1 natural, +2 size)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +0
Immune acid

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee bite +5 (1d3-3 + 1d4 acid)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 5, Dex 17, Con 10, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 4
Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 8 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Perception +8, Stealth +15; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Familiar

The master of a sepse familiar gains acid resistance 5.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm deserts
Organization solitary, pair, or nest (1-6)
Treasure none

A sepse’s bite injects acid into the victim rather than venom, melting it from the inside. This snake lives in holes among the desert’s rocks.
